notes: Concept hook 'TEM DÚVIDA DE CONFIG? PERGUNTA PRA IA.' (7 words) split into hook card 'TEM DÚVIDA DE CONFIG?' + second card 'PERGUNTA PRA KIZUAI' (≤6 words per card). The example answer is shown as 'Na aba Fishing, escolha um modo:' + the 6 real mode names as chips (instead of one 103-char sentence) to respect reading speed. Added a second example turn ('e os minigames?' → 'Ficam na aba Farming.', grounded in the module list where Farming = resources, minigames, headbutt, professions) plus a pinned 'contexto' chip to show context memory. Whole exchange labelled 'exemplo'; chat UI is a generic brand-styled design. Seamless loop bridge back to the hook frame.
